name: data-mining-masters-ai-data-sourcing
description: Find AI data providers, compare licensing options, and prepare data partnership briefs using public sources and your requirements.

interface.longDescription: A three-skill research toolkit from Data Mining Masters. Find AI data providers or licensing partners, compare access and published terms, and prepare a metadata-only partnership brief with a draft inquiry. Distinguishes buying data from licensing out data, cites supporting sources, and identifies unknown eligibility, prices, and rights. Uses your agent's available web tools for current research; comparisons and briefs also work from supplied materials. No bundled server, API key, or private account connection is required. Does not submit applications, purchase data, or send outreach automatically.
defaultPrompt: Find AI data providers for my project and explain what I need to verify.
Compare my shortlisted data providers using sourced facts and clear evidence gaps.
Turn my data inventory into a partnership brief and draft inquiry.
